nieuw.titel: Offset supporting units beyond the bait's overrun path
nieuw.tekst: When deploying a supporting unit behind bait, leave enough sideways separation that an enemy charging the bait cannot overrun into the support. Use the supporting unit's wider field of view from further back when choosing that spacing.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that pulling a unit back widens its field of view, allowing greater separation. His support was too close to the bait and lay directly in the enemy's overrun path.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Great Eagle baited Wild Riders, but their overrun could also reach his Lothern Skycutter. He says the Skycutter could have been further sideways while still sheltering behind the woods; only a short overrun roll allowed it to escape next turn.

nieuw.waarom: He describes the pair as inexpensive and says both have movement ten, letting them move quickly up a quiet flank.
